name: Xero Developer Remote MCP
summary: Xero's hosted MCP server (api.xero.com/mcp/v1) with 39 tools for invoicing, accounting, reporting and payments, for commercial apps on Core or above.
description: Launched 2026-10-15 per the Xero developer changelog. Agents connect to https://api.xero.com/mcp/v1 and sign in with Xero's normal OAuth 2.0 flow; Xero recommends PKCE apps (no client secret to leak into prompts or configs); web-app tokens work but are discouraged. Each call runs against one organisation; `get_connected_tenants` lists them. A tool is callable only if the app holds its scope (e.g. accounting.invoices for create_invoice, accounting.reports.trialbalance.read for list_trial_balance). Write tools start with create_, update_, authorise_ or void_. Included at no extra charge for Commercial apps on the Core plan or above; Starter apps can try it with a demo organisation. Data egress, rate limits and connection counts use the normal API limits. Separate from the open-source local xero-mcp server. Per the FAQ: V1 tools don't ask the user for confirmation; API calls (not prompts or tool calls) are logged in the Developer Portal; Custom Connection apps aren't eligible; accountants and bookkeepers get MCP use under the API fee exemption; limits are 1,000 calls a day per organisation on Starter and 5,000 on Core and above; clients must support OAuth with PKCE.

agent_access.notes: OAuth 2.0 (PKCE recommended); protected-resource metadata at https://api.xero.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp/v1. Requires a Commercial app on Core or above (Starter: demo organisation only).
